mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that commercial banks get fewer amounts by selling securities to the central bank."
A high discount rate means that commercial banks get fewer amounts by selling securities to the central bank.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which bring changes in the consumer demand for commodities."
Structural changes are those which bring changes in the consumer demand for commodities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of the final expenditure on goods and services produced in a country measured at market prices."
Under the expenditure method GDP is the sum of the final expenditure on goods and services produced in a country measured at market prices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a problem that each society faces, and each society must find a way to beat it."
Unemployment is a problem that each society faces, and each society must find a way to beat it.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the body of economics thought developed by John Maynard Keynes who held the view that a capitalist system did not automatically tends towards full employment equilibrium."
Keynesian Economics is the body of economics thought developed by John Maynard Keynes who held the view that a capitalist system did not automatically tends towards full employment equilibrium.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the graphical tool that professor Philips uses in illustrating the trade of that existed between unemployment and inflation when he carried out his research in the United States of America."

The Philips curve is the graphical tool that professor Philips uses in illustrating the trade of that existed between unemployment and inflation when he carried out his research in the United States of America.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the base for the expansion of bank deposits and creation of money supply varies directly with changes in the monetary base and inversely with the currency and reserves ratios. 5."

High powered money is the base for the expansion of bank deposits and creation of money supply varies directly with changes in the monetary base and inversely with the currency and reserves ratios. 5.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a salient form of dumping."
An export subsidy is a salient form of dumping.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the purchase of a foreign currency in a market where its price is low and to sell it in some other market where price is high."
Arbitrage refers to the purchase of a foreign currency in a market where its price is low and to sell it in some other market where price is high.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that a recession strikes harder and does a lot more damage."
Recklessness in public finances means that a recession strikes harder and does a lot more damage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rate at which the demand for foreign exchange equals to the supply of foreign exchange."
The equilibrium exchange rate is the rate at which the demand for foreign exchange equals to the supply of foreign exchange.

Inflation

terms of trade

import tariff
